'''Kasımpaşa Spor Kulübü''' ({{IPA|tr|kaˈsɯmpaʃa}}), commercially registered as '''Kasımpaşa Sportif Faaliyetler A.Ş.''' and commonly referred to simply as '''Kasımpaşa''', is a Turkish professional football club based in the [[Kasımpaşa, Beyoğlu|Kasımpaşa]] neighbourhood, [[Beyoğlu]] district of [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. Founded in 1921, the club has a long-standing presence in Turkish football and has competed in various divisions of the national league system, spending much of its modern history in the [[Süper Lig]], the highest tier of Turkish football.

Kasımpaşa play their home matches at the [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadium]], located in the [[Kasımpaşa, Beyoğlu|Kasımpaşa]] neighbourhood of Beyoğlu. The stadium, which has a capacity of approximately 14,000 spectators, is named after the current President of Turkey, [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]], who was born and raised in the area and played for the club at youth level.

As of the [[2026–27 Süper Lig|2026–27 Süper Lig]] season, Kasımpaşa is one of five clubs from Istanbul competing in the Turkish top flight, alongside [[Fenerbahçe S.K.|Fenerbahçe]], [[Galatasaray S.K.|Galatasaray]], [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] and [[İstanbul Başakşehir F.K.|İstanbul Başakşehir]].

In November 2021, Kasımpaşa officially marked its centenary with a series of events and commemorations celebrating its 100 years of existence, paying tribute to its historical roots, local community ties, and enduring presence in Turkish football culture."}}
